channel.title: The Assam Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Assam Tribune (assamtribune.com)

item.title: Bangladesh’s political shift raises serious security concerns for Assam & NE
item.description: Security agencies warn of growing Islamist and jihadi influence in Bangladesh, with Jamaat-e-Islami gaining strength, raising serious concerns for Northeast

item.title: Mamata orders inquiry, organiser detained after chaos at Messi event in Kolkata
item.description: Following chaotic scenes at the Messi event, West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee ordered a high-level inquiry and apologised to fans.

item.title: Majuli erosion control measures hit by unstable soil, Brahmaputra Board orders studies
item.description: The Brahmaputra Board has launched fresh geotechnical and hydrological studies as Phase-V protection works begin.

item.title: GMC directs schools in Guwahati to remove stray dogs as dog bite cases surge
item.description: The Gauhati Municipal Corporation has directed schools to remove stray dogs from campuses and enforce strict safety measures to protect children.

item.title: NFR upgrades trains, bridges, cargo terminals & passenger amenities in Assam
item.description: Northeast Frontier Railway modernises infrastructure with LHB train rakes, pathways on 550+ bridges, six Gati Shakti cargo terminals, and plastic waste management

item.title: Rabha groups protest at Jantar Mantar, renew demand for sixth schedule status
item.description: Nearly 500 Rabha protesters staged a demonstration at Jantar Mantar, urging the Centre to grant Sixth Schedule status to the Rabha Hasong Autonomous Council

item.title: Illegal sand mining along Brahmaputra raises alarm in Palasbari area
item.description: Rampant illegal sand mining in Jarabari-Panikhaiti stretch have sparked concerns over environmental damage and alleged official inaction.

item.title: Aizawl mourns quiet street minstrel C Rothangpuia, who passed away on Dec 12
item.description: C Rothangpuia, Aizawl’s familiar street guitarist whose soft songs blended into everyday life, passed away on December 12, leaving the city’s streets emptier.

item.title: Nagaland seeks IAF aerial support as Dzukou Valley wildfire enters Day 3
item.description: Officials said four local trekkers accidentally triggered the wildfire after lighting a campfire that spiralled out of control

item.title: Grenade threat forces shutdown of all petrol pumps across Imphal valley
item.description: On December 13 a hand grenade and threat letter were found at a filling station, prompting safety concerns and fuel shortages.
